entities.summary: Jean Claude Marc Raymond, nicknamed "Frenchy", is a Canadian former professional baseball relief pitcher, coach, and broadcaster. During his 12-year career in Major League Baseball, he played for the Chicago White Sox (1959), Milwaukee/Atlanta Braves, Houston Colt .45s/Astros (1964–67) and Montreal Expos (1969–71).
